Orders & Quotes — How It Works

The process for all three businesses is kept simple — every section in its place, every order in its place:

I.

3 Animated Sections

The moment the site opens, all three businesses appear one by one — each with its own full animation: a moving elevator, a fire alarm with extinguisher, and a shelf of cleaning products.

II.

VIEW PRODUCTS → Cart

Products never appear directly in a section — beneath every animation sits VIEW PRODUCTS, and the cards open only when it is clicked. FIRE CARE ZONE products collect in the side cart with ADD TO CART, and the order is sent over WhatsApp. Clean Ways Enterprise products are coming soon.

III.

Elevators = WhatsApp Quote

A lift's price cannot be fixed without a survey, so instead of a cart there is a GET QUOTE button that takes the customer straight to WhatsApp (0306 9440025).
